chunks: The shaykh, the jurist, Abū Yaʿlā Sallār ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Daylamī.

key_terms.ٱلدَّيْلَمِيُّ: the attribution indicating origin or association with Daylam
key_terms.ٱلشَّيْخُ: a senior religious scholar or learned master

ai.seo_question: Who was Abū Yaʿlā Sallār ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Daylamī?
ai.summary: This text is a brief biographical identification of the scholar Abū Yaʿlā Sallār ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Daylamī. It presents him with honorific scholarly titles, indicating his standing as a shaykh and jurist within the learned tradition.
